architecture_principles: a discovered material regularity is only usable inside the chemistry family in which it was measured
a scientific applicability boundary is executable code, not prompt advice
the language model may criticize the rule and may not override it
value of information is computed by a deterministic tool over the admissible set only
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
every gate decision carries a machine-readable reason and is serialized with the run

arm_difference_declaration.forbidden_confound: Hiding applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL is prohibited by protocol v1.1.
held_identical: model endpoint and stage model assignment
evidence access profile and filtered evidence state
raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for every candidate
the full inadmissible-card list and its machine-readable reasons
VOI implementation, weights and tie epsilon
arm_difference_declaration.information_parity_evidence: build_pre_enforcement_payload() takes no arm argument, and its SHA-256 is written into every run as pre_enforcement_payload_sha256. The two arms must report the same hash.
arm_difference_declaration.only_intended_difference: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
arm_difference_declaration.payload_consequence: Both arms receive the same audit, the same per-candidate applicability outputs and the same inadmissible-card list. V5_NO_GATE marks the audit advisory and keeps every card selectable; V5_FULL marks it binding and removes the inadmissible cards from the ranked set.

candidate_space.rationale: V5 reuses the byte-identical V3/V4 lattice so that the measured change is the chemistry-domain constraint, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> mandatory chemistry-audited local science tool -> deterministic chemistry-domain applicability audit (identical and model-visible in both arms) -> enforcement (V5_FULL only) -> VOI over the selectable set -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze

rules: M-HOLD-120 is admissible: it measures thermal-hold drift directly and does not use the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT is admissible: it measures realization/state spread directly.
M-SWEEP is admissible: it is the direct verification measurement for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use equal to allowed_with_state_anchor, or when configs/verified_shape_transfer.json records a completed direct sweep for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification. This is deterministic inadmissibility, not a VOI penalty and not prompt advice.

architecture.claim_boundary: V5.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime with a deterministic chemistry-domain admissibility constraint. A V5 result is evidence about executable scientific constraints on measurement choice. It is not a wet-lab result and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.manuscript_boundary: V5 run results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the run series is audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_CHEMISTRY_GATED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V5
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information or admissibility
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
re-running, rewriting or reinterpreting the frozen V4 series

primary_arms.role: advice-only control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint
prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

architecture.purpose: Test whether an experimentally discovered material regularity and its chemistry-domain boundary can be executed as a hard scientific constraint on which measurement an outcome-blind Agent is allowed to select.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question the next experiment must answer, and request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations
execute read-only scientific tools. The chemistry-audited local rheology summary is mandatory and is forced into the trace whether or not the planner requested it.

deterministic, non-LLM measurement-applicability audit. Computed once per run without reference to the arm, fully visible to the model in both arms, serialized in full, and never produced by a model stage.
V5_FULL only. Converts the identical audit into hard admissibility before VOI ranking and again at freeze. It cannot be overridden by any model stage.
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value from the cards present in the payload
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability and whether its falsification criterion can actually be met
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported weight sensitivity and the strongest objection
commit to one experiment card present in the payload, or abstain, and state its acceptance and falsification criteria
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card. A selection outside the admissible set is rejected at freeze rather than repaired.

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V5 is a new prospective runtime. configs/agent_v4.json, scripts/run_agent_v4.py, prompts/agent_v4_*.txt, src/pur_new/voi.py and every frozen V3/V4 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V5.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards

decision_stability_sent_to_model.evaluated_over: the selectable experiment cards of this arm
decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Accept the state-control objective if S_max is less than or equal to 100.0%, equivalently if the largest max/min viscosity-scale ratio across the three preparations at both 120 and 130 C is less than or equal to 2.00. This beats the historical E2 ratios of 2.80-3.57 but does not by itself validate the separate 3.40-percentage-point level-classification threshold.
judge_normalized.chemistry_support_statement: No: this primary observable does not depend on a prior rheological regularity measured in the same chemistry family as S1C41. It is obtained from direct 80-130 C sweeps of three preparations of the resin-modified AC1920+TK100 chemistry. This avoids transferring the unmodified-family thermal shape, but supports only a formulation-level reproducibility claim; it cannot establish a molecular mechanism, classify the level hypotheses without a matched E2 comparison, or establish thermal-hold stability.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: If S_max is greater than 100.0%, equivalently if the max/min viscosity-scale ratio exceeds 2.00 at either 120 or 130 C, the proposition that this three-preparation protocol adequately controls realization-state ambiguity is falsified. Neither an outcome at or below 100.0% nor one above 100.0% directly falsifies H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC, because this card has no contemporaneous replicated E2 comparator and therefore leaves all three registered level hypotheses entangled.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run a tightened-process repeatability study with independently prepared, contemporaneous, blocked S1C41 and unmodified E2 samples, using direct 80-130 C sweeps and a predefined 120/130 C comparison rule; only after the relative-level uncertainty is quantified should the -72.76%, -42.76%, and 17.24% prediction thresholds be applied. A repeated M-HOLD-120 must subsequently test the separate residence-time drift failure mode.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: The worst-case between-preparation viscosity-scale spread across the three independent S1C41 preparations at 120 and 130 C, reported as S_max = max_T{100 * [exp(max(a_fr,T) - min(a_fr,T)) - 1]} percent for T = 120 and 130 C.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C41::M-REPEAT is chemistry-admissible under the binding audit and directly measures the modified material without unsupported shared-shape transfer. Its main value is state control, not immediate hypothesis discrimination or mitigation of hot-hold drift. The numeric criterion tests whether preparation spread is reduced below a 2.00-fold ratio; all three level hypotheses and the separate thermal-hold failure mode remain unresolved afterward.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I follow the Skeptic and Robustness Adjudicator over the Proposer on measurement choice. The Proposer's S1C41::M-SWEEP is deterministically top-ranked and stable to the tested weight perturbations, but one preparation cannot sustain a 3.40-percentage-point formulation-level classification against the observed E2 realization spread; ranking stability is not evidential confidence. I therefore select the Robustness Adjudicator's S1C41::M-REPEAT to control realization ambiguity first. I retain the Proposer's candidate tie-break because S1C41 is the smallest total modifier burden among the five tied top candidates.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: There are only three historical E2 realizations, no contemporaneous replicated E2 control in this card, and no acrylic-only or tackifier-only controls. Thus modifier-axis attribution and exact between-formulation level classification remain unresolved.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: S1C41 uses 15% acrylic-like and 5% tackifier-like loading within the stated evidence-supported regions, but the AC1920+TK100 chemistry has no prior verified shared-shape transfer. Direct repeated sweeps remove thermal-shape transfer as an assumption for this experiment.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: Direct sweeps avoid one-point shape reconstruction, but instrument uncertainty is not separately reported. The adjudication therefore uses the catalog's numeric 100.0% state-control threshold rather than the 3.40% single-curve fit residual.

planner.chemistry_support_statement: The local temperature-response regularities were measured in the original reactive PUR family represented by E1, E2, and E3 over 80-130 C, with E1 +P retained only as a separate phosphoric-acid perturbation check. An experiment introducing acrylic-like or minor-tackifier-like material into the E2 core would not automatically remain inside that measured chemistry support. Its shared-shape applicability must be audited; otherwise the processing-window level must be measured directly with a temperature sweep rather than inferred from a one-point anchor.
planner.failure_mode: Excessive isothermal viscosity rise during hot residence, creating thermal-hold instability in the local design family.
planner.failure_mode_evidence: At 120 C, original formulation E5 showed SI_15_60 = 0.5154 and SI_15_90 = 0.9308, corresponding to approximately 52% and 93% viscosity increases; the original E1 contrast was only approximately 9.5% and 16.8%, respectively.
planner.least_resolved_justification: Only two original 120 C hold trajectories are available, for E1 and E5, with four points each over 15-90 min and no reported independent repeats. They show a large formulation contrast but do not establish repeatability, modifier dependence, or the trajectory of the E2 reactive-core anchor. Temperature response is supported by multiple six-point 80-130 C sweeps, whereas realized level, although highly variable for E2, has measurements at every 10 C across that range.
measurement_requirements: Directly measure viscosity at 120 and 130 C for any chemistry-changing candidate; use the full 80-130 C sweep unless the chemistry-domain audit explicitly supports the shared-shape one-point calibration.

Compare the matched-state realized level with the frozen inert-dilution prediction and classify it as within measurement resolution, above it, or below it so that H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC are prospectively separable.

Use independent preparations or equivalent state controls sufficient to distinguish formulation effects from the E2 nominal run spread, whose measured CV is approximately 0.46-0.58 and whose max/min ratio is approximately 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C.
Measure a repeated 120 C hold at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min and report SI_15_60 without extrapolation, so the candidate can be compared with the original high-drift E5 and lower-drift E1 references.
Preserve the source viscosity unit as unknown and avoid molecular-mechanism claims from rheology alone.
planner.scientific_question: For an E2-anchored formulation containing a nonzero acrylic-like and/or minor-tackifier-like modifier, is the realized viscosity level at matched process state and 120-130 C consistent with inert dilution, measurably above dilution as predicted by H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or measurably below dilution as predicted by H-LEVEL-PLASTIC, while avoiding the large 120 C residence-time drift observed locally?

proposer.chemistry_support_assessment: S1C41 is resin-modified AC1920+TK100 chemistry outside the family in which the shared thermal-response shape was measured. M-SWEEP remains admissible under the binding audit because it directly measures the processing-window level and establishes the thermal-response shape for this chemistry rather than transferring the unmodified-family shape. Its 15% acrylic-like and 5% minor-tackifier-like loadings both lie within the externally supported intervention regions.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: A measured 120-130 C level change within 3.40 percentage points of exactly one registered prediction supports that formulation-level rule for S1C41: -42.76% supports H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 17.24% supports H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or -72.76% supports H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. This establishes the processing-window level classification for this composition but does not establish a molecular mechanism or thermal-hold stability.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the level change is at or below -42.76%; H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above -42.76%; and H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the result differs from -42.76% by more than 3.40 percentage points. Thus an outcome can directly reject the favored directional rule even though another registered rule may remain viable.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result not within 3.40 percentage points of exactly one prediction would leave the three-rule classification unresolved or reject their exact pre-registered quantitative forms at this composition. Given the large historical E2 preparation-to-preparation spread and the card's moderate process-state risk, such a result would also motivate state-controlled replication before assigning the deviation to formulation chemistry.

proposer.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level at 120 and 130 C within the 80-130 C sweep, reported as level change versus the unmodified E2 reactive core; the sweep also yields the fitted apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: Deterministically tied and equally discriminating, but uses 17.5% acrylic plus 5% tackifier, a larger chemistry perturbation than S1C41 without additional information value.
Deterministically tied and located at a directly supported 20% acrylic anchor, but its 25% total modifier burden is larger than the minimum sufficient tied intervention.
Deterministically tied but imposes a still larger 27.5% total modifier burden, with no gain in pairwise hypothesis separation or measurement directness.

Deterministically tied but uses the largest perturbation in the tied set, 25% acrylic plus 5% tackifier, contrary to the minimum-sufficient-intervention rule when information value is otherwise identical.

Separates all three hypothesis pairs directly, but its 7.5% tackifier loading lies 1.1 percentage points above the repeatedly supported 4.8-6.4% cluster, producing an extrapolation penalty and a lower VOI score.

proposer.reasoning: S1C41::M-SWEEP has the top stable VOI score, directly measures the decision quantity at 120-130 C, separates all three registered hypothesis pairs, and avoids the inadmissible one-point shape transfer into modified chemistry. Within the genuine five-way tie, S1C41 is the smallest externally supported dual-axis intervention. The experiment does not answer thermal-hold drift, so a repeated M-HOLD-120 would remain necessary for the separate residence-time failure mode.
proposer.tie_break_justification: All five tied sweeps directly separate all three hypothesis pairs with the same VOI component vector and no extrapolation penalty. S1C41 is selected because it uses the smallest total modifier burden and smallest justified departure from the characterized E2 core: 15% acrylic-like plus 5% tackifier-like. The acrylic loading is in the conservative initial test band, and the 5% tackifier loading is in the repeatedly documented 4.8-6.4% cluster.

robustness_adjudication.change_from_proposal: Changed the measurement from S1C41::M-SWEEP to S1C41::M-REPEAT. This is a scientifically justified departure from the deterministic ranking because the historical E2 realization spread makes the proposed single-preparation sweep inadequate for formulation-level discrimination at 3.40 percentage points. The candidate remains S1C41 because the five-way top tie provides no hypothesis-separation advantage for another tied composition, while S1C41 has the smallest total modifier burden. M-REPEAT remains chemistry-admissible because it directly sweeps the modified material rather than transferring the unmodified-family thermal shape.
residual_decision_risk: S1C41::M-REPEAT lacks a contemporaneous, replicated, state-matched unmodified E2 control, so it cannot by itself validate the percent-change denominator or establish formulation-level differences at the declared 3.40-percentage-point threshold.
Three preparations may still be insufficient to reduce uncertainty to 3.40 percentage points given the historically large realization variability.
The rule for combining or requiring agreement between the directly measured 120 C and 130 C levels remains unspecified.
A dual-axis S1C41 experiment cannot attribute a result specifically to AC1920, TK100, or their interaction without acrylic-only and tackifier-only controls.
Neither M-REPEAT nor the proposed M-SWEEP establishes mitigation of the separate 120 C residence-time drift failure mode; repeated M-HOLD-120 testing remains necessary.
Rheological outcomes cannot establish molecular association or plasticization mechanisms.
The modified chemistry has no prior verified shared-shape transfer; future use of M-ANCHOR would require direct-sweep verification for the same chemistry family and a versioned prior.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: Although S1C41::M-SWEEP is in the deterministic tied top set and directly measures the modified chemistry, its one-preparation protocol cannot support the claimed formulation-level 3.40-percentage-point discrimination against an E2 reference with 46-58% CV and 2.80-3.57-fold preparation spread. This is not merely a limitation on molecular interpretation: it undermines the operational separation and falsification of the registered formulation-level hypotheses. Among the available cards, S1C41::M-REPEAT most directly addresses this unencoded failure by measuring three independently prepared S1C41 realizations across 80-130 C. It should therefore precede a one-preparation classification claim. It still does not supply the contemporaneous replicated E2 comparator requested by the Skeptic, so the exact hypothesis thresholds remain unusable without further comparison data.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: The tied top set was unchanged in all 29 tested scenarios: top_experiment_set_stability was 1.0, and every weight term survived scaling from 0.5 to 1.5 with no recommendation_flip_boundary. No tested perturbation caused S1C41::M-SWEEP to cease being top ranked. The base_margin_to_first_strictly_lower was only 0.002292, but that small margin did not produce a flip within the reported sweep. Weightings outside the tested range were not evaluated, and reweighting cannot repair the protocol's unencoded realization-state and comparator deficiencies.

skeptic.chemistry_domain_support_assessment: The primary 120 and 130 C viscosity measurements are obtained directly on S1C41, so they do not reuse the unmodified-family shared thermal-response shape outside its support. M-SWEEP is appropriate and admissible for this modified chemistry. Any later use of M-ANCHOR for AC1920+TK100 would require this direct sweep to verify transferability for the same chemistry family and to be entered as a versioned prior.
skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The instrument can produce a point estimate on either side of the stated thresholds, but the protocol cannot establish a formulation-level departure at the asserted 3.40-percentage-point resolution. That number is a curve-fit residual, whereas the required contrast is a relative change against a highly variable E2 realization. With one S1C41 preparation, no contemporaneous E2 control, and no confidence or repeatability rule, crossing a threshold does not constitute attainable scientific falsification.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A realization-specific viscosity displacement could be classified as H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC even though the experiment has not isolated a formulation-level effect.
objections.objection: The numerical predictions for S1C41 are widely separated (-72.76%, -42.76%, and 17.24%), but the claimed 3.40-percentage-point discrimination resolution is not the resolution of the proposed between-formulation comparison. M-SWEEP specifies only one freshly prepared S1C41 sample, while the E2 reference has a measured CV of 0.46-0.58 and max/min ratios of 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C. Without replicated, state-matched E2 and S1C41 preparations, all three level hypotheses remain operationally entangled with realization state. Therefore proposer.hypotheses_not_separated = [] is not justified in practice.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The result may discriminate pre-registered formulation-level prediction values, but claims that AC1920 caused association or that both modifiers caused plasticization would be unsupported.
objections.objection: S1C41 changes three linked quantities at once: AC1920 is introduced at 15%, TK100 at 5%, and the reactive E2 core is reduced to 80%. A single dual-axis composition can test the three exact quantitative prediction rules because their predicted levels differ, but it cannot attribute any elevation specifically to acrylic-like association, any depression specifically to either modifier's plasticization, or any result to AC1920-TK100 interaction. Those axis-specific mechanism attributions require acrylic-only and tackifier-only controls or a factorial comparison.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The reported percent change and its assignment to a 3.40-percentage-point acceptance window could depend on an unstated reference or aggregation rule rather than a directly observed matched-state contrast.
objections.objection: The candidate viscosities at 120 and 130 C are directly measured, so they do not depend on the fitted shared thermal shape. However, the stated primary decision observable is the percent level change versus unmodified E2, which is not available from the candidate sweep alone. The protocol does not specify a contemporaneous E2 comparator, pairing or blocking, which E2 historical realization defines the denominator, or how the 120 and 130 C values are combined into one '120-130 C level change.' The 3.40% figure is the residual of a shared-shape-plus-intercept fit, not demonstrated uncertainty for this relative level-change observable. The fitted E_eta descriptor also inherits the ln(eta) versus 1/T regression assumptions, although it is secondary to the level decision.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: No chemistry-domain transfer claim is unsupported by the selected protocol; the direct sweep is the required verification measurement.
objections.objection: This attack surface is survived. S1C41 is explicitly identified as resin-modified AC1920+TK100 chemistry outside the previously measured unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI support, and the selected M-SWEEP directly measures 80-130 C rather than reconstructing 120-130 C from the unmodified-family shared shape. The proposal does not reuse that shape outside its measured support.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A single preparation could formally cross a falsification boundary because of preparation state or reference choice, producing rejection of a formulation-level hypothesis without measurement precision adequate to support that rejection.
objections.objection: The directional thresholds are numerically reachable, but they are not operationally valid falsification criteria under the specified one-preparation protocol. H-LEVEL-DILUTE is said to be falsified by a departure greater than 3.40 percentage points, yet M-SWEEP has min_repeats = 1 and does not control process state, while E2's observed preparation spread is orders of magnitude larger than 3.40 percentage points. The association and plasticization criteria likewise compare a noisy relative level estimate directly with -42.76% without an uncertainty rule or state-matched comparator.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The valid rheological classification could be overstated as proof of molecular association, plasticization, or successful mitigation of the known 120 C hold-drift failure mode.
objections.objection: No unmeasured S1C41 outcome is used in the stated predictions or tie-break, and the proposer explicitly limits the conclusion to formulation-level level classification rather than a molecular mechanism. It also correctly admits that M-SWEEP does not establish thermal-hold stability. The only scope risk is that labels such as 'acrylic-associative' and 'plasticizing' must not be interpreted mechanistically from rheology alone, especially with both modifier axes changed together.

skeptic.recommended_change: Run independently prepared, contemporaneous and preferably blocked 80-130 C sweeps for both S1C41 and the unmodified E2 control, with enough replicates to estimate the 120 and 130 C level-change confidence interval and demonstrate that its uncertainty is at most the declared 3.40 percentage points before applying the hypothesis thresholds. Predefine whether classification requires agreement at both 120 and 130 C or a specified aggregate. If modifier-axis attribution is intended, add acrylic-only and tackifier-only sweep controls. Separately run repeated M-HOLD-120 measurements before making any claim about mitigation of the residence-time failure mode.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The proposed single-preparation M-SWEEP claims 3.40-percentage-point discrimination against an E2 reference whose measured preparation variability is approximately 46-58% CV with 2.80-3.57-fold max/min spread. Because no contemporaneous replicated E2 comparator or replicated S1C41 preparation is specified, formulation-level change cannot be separated from realization state at the declared resolution.

tool_trace.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: This mandatory upstream audit must be loaded first to establish the chemistry provenance, shared thermal-shape evidence, state-shift behavior, calibration error, hold contrast, and separate E1 +P perturbation result before candidate or experiment ranking is admissible.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation is excluded from the primary same-composition fit and is interpreted separately as a chemical-perturbation check.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.
Keep deliberately chemistry-perturbed curves outside same-composition fitting, but use them to test whether an intervention shifts viscosity scale, thermal-response shape, or both.

chemical_perturbation_check.interpretation: The verified low-dose H3PO4 perturbation shifts the observed viscosity level while remaining closely compatible with the local shared thermal-response geometry. It is a separate chemical-perturbation check and is not pooled into the primary same-composition state model.

observational_E1_R01_day1_comparator.interpretation_boundary: Observational reference only; the compact record does not establish a paired parent-batch relationship between E1 +P and E1 R01 day-1.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.
experiment_design_implications.verified_acid_perturbation: E1 +P received 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution during dehydration. Its close agreement with the primary shared thermal shape makes it useful as a defined scale-versus-shape perturbation check, not as another nominal E1 realization.

provenance_audit.reason: E1 +P is a verified chemical perturbation: 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution was added during dehydration. It is excluded from the same-composition primary state model and exposed separately as a perturbation check.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

chemistry_applicability_audit.enforcement_note: In this condition the chemistry applicability audit is BINDING. The cards it marks inadmissible were removed before ranking and are not selectable. You may state that you disagree with the rule and why; naming a removed card is an invalid output.
rule_text: Scope: measurement admissibility, not formulation admissibility.
M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT and M-SWEEP observe their quantity directly and remain admissible.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct sweep has verified transferability for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification: the one-point anchor would reconstruct 120-130 C viscosity through a shape that has never been measured for that chemistry.
This audit is a deterministic scientific rule, not a VOI penalty and not a model opinion. Whether it is binding in this run is stated by the enforcement field.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.
